verdict.rationale: Codex CLI's code is published in a public GitHub repository (github.com/openai/codex, including the codex-rs source tree). A community user contrasts the closed-source Codex App with the CLI, implying the CLI is open source. The pack never names the license, and the desktop App and cloud agent appear to be closed. Missing for 10: an explicit open-source license statement, source availability for the App and cloud components, and first-party documentation of openness.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license

citations.quote: Codex CLI is a coding agent from OpenAI that runs locally on your computer.
